params.name: compute_disk_util
params.label: Compute disk space utilization
params.description: Enable checking disk space used by each plugin. Checking this box populates the column named 'plugin_disk_space_size_MB'. WARNING: This adds at least 30 seconds per plugin, so checking a DSS Node with 280 installed plugins takes almost 2.5 hours to run.
